title: Malicious code in @kropaku/baileys (npm)
description: The @kropaku/baileys npm package is a fork of the Baileys WhatsApp library that contains malicious code designed to covertly relay data or exfiltrate credentials. It includes obfuscated code that decodes a hidden HTTPS endpoint unrelated to the original project and integrates this endpoint into the message sending process. The obfuscation and concealed network destination indicate an intent to hide unauthorized data transmission within a WhatsApp session library.
